maintenance_set.principle: A document that describes what a script can check should be replaced by the script; one that records why cannot be.
maintenance_set.gate_note: The gate is purpose-built for this submodule. It was previously a byte-identical copy of the _sphinx_ai_assistant checker and failed by construction with 23 errors; it now recomputes physical totals and enforces the proposed-move invariant.

physical_totals.counting_rule: source_loc_all_files counts newlines in every regular file under a recorded path; source_loc_code_only counts newlines in .py and .js files only. Both are recomputed by check_trackers.py. The former single 'source_loc: 9896' was not reproducible under either rule: it mixed code-only counts for _hf_spaces_proxy/_hf_spaces_model with an all-files count for _cf_worker, and recorded dev_proxy.py as ~1800 lines when it is 362.
